name: Demonic Avatar

body:
DEMONIC AVATAR
CR 12

XP 19,200
CE Medium humanoid/outsider (gnoll)
Init +7, Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +16

DEFENSE

AC 27, touch 20, flat-footed 24 (+3 Dex, +4 mage armor, +6 deflection, +4 natural)
hp 136 (13d10 +65)
Fort +12, Ref +7, Will +10
Immunities Mind

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee flail +10 (1d8 +4)
Spells Prepared (CL 13th)

7th-mage’s sword
6th–disintegrate, symbol of fear
5th–cloudkill, cone of cold, hold monster
4th–contagion, crushing despair, fire shield, ice storm, wall of fire
3rd–fireball, haste, keen edge, slow
2nd–blur, glitterdust, levitate, scorching ray
1st–burning hands, obscuring mist, ray of enfeeblement, shocking grasp
0th–dancing lights, flare, message open/close

STATISTICS

Str 13, Dex 16, Con 18, Int 20, Wis 14, Cha 13
Base Atk +5; CMB +6, CMD 18
Feats Improved Initiative, toughness

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Fanaticism (Ex)

The gnoll prophet is immune to all charm and fear effects. He has special bonuses to hit and bonus damage with a flail. Both are noted above.
